goal: Open a new sub-account for the member, funded from their Savings with the opening deposit, and read the new account number and the confirmation reference from the confirmation screen.
description: Open a sub-account for a member, funded from their Savings, and return the new account number and the confirmation reference.

nickname.description: Name the member gives the sub-account

openingDeposit.description: Amount moved from Savings into the new sub-account

newAccountNumber.description: Account number of the new sub-account

confirmationRef.description: Reference to give the member; also what reconciliation looks up
